text: Mark Rendon (Green) carries a campaign platform point calling for divestment of state funds from corporations complicit in genocide, adoption of BDS standards for state expenditures, and repeal of California laws prohibiting educators from teaching about the genocide in Palestine. Vote for Peace rates him Ally in the general phase. No Israel-aligned endorsement appears in his documented record. Buffy Wicks (Democrat) stated on October 10, 2023, that she "stands with the Israeli people" and called the Hamas attack "terrorism, plain and simple." She voted Aye on AB 715, creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel, endorsed her in the primary with explicit carry-forward to the general election. The saved selection names Rendon as the strongest candidate in this AD-14 State Assembly race.
